notes: Windows Recruitment Hub v1.1.49 — Two small live timers appear beside each Pipeline candidate's current stage: STEP (time since entering the current unfinished checklist step) and TOTAL (time since recruitment pipeline started). Each exact clock uses green/on track, orange/check, or red/overdue colours. Stage windows reflect operational expectations (contract signature initial check from 3h; Cortex training readiness orange after 48h/red after 72h; training verification orange after 24h); other stages use advisory follow-up thresholds. Overall pipeline turns orange after 7 days and red after 14 days. The timers refresh every minute without rerendering cards, changing sort order or interrupting editing. For older imported candidates without trustworthy timestamps, unknown times display — or a grey ≥ minimum elapsed since the first recorded step, never a fabricated start date. Finished and archived stages do not continue ticking. Existing 1/11 counts, short green bar, current stage text, manual Re-sort, official MBL sync and all checklist data remain unchanged.
